note: reasoned audit rows, ADR 058 Part 1; severity = likely effect on a decision

rows.inputs_and_clocks: GC=F settle of D-1 (13:30 ET = 17:30/18:30 UTC D-1) x INR=X bar D-1 (snapshot ~00-02 UTC D-1), labelled D, set against IBJA fixes of D (06:30/11:30 UTC)
rows.issue: none: no value is used before it was known. By design, the COMEX input is ~17 h old and the FX input ~30 h old at the PM fix
rows.proposed_fix: none (state the staleness in the docstring)

rows.analysis: INR proxy, label series (ADR 032 lag sweep)
rows.inputs_and_clocks: GC=F settle of D (17:30/18:30 UTC D, 6-7 h AFTER IBJA PM D) x INR=X bar D (~00-02 UTC D, before it)
rows.issue: misalignment: the label straddles the fix, so neither lag 0 nor lag -1 is the fix-time price. ADR 032 swept only daily closes, then concluded 'timing misalignment does NOT explain the ~33% disagreement'. It never tested the price at the fix time
rows.proposed_fix: build the label from COMEX x FX known at the IBJA fix (1-hour bars exist from 2024-05; before that, keep the daily label and state its 6-7 h lead)

rows.inputs_and_clocks: reading timestamp ts (UTC) joined to the macro row of ts's UTC calendar date: GC=F settle D (17:30-18:30 UTC), ^VIX/^TNX/DXY closes D (~20-21 UTC), INR=X D, ^BSESN D (10:00 UTC)
rows.issue: leak: a reading at 03:00 UTC D gets values published 7-18 h later. The lags are also calendar-row lags of a forward-filled frame
rows.severity: high if reused; dormant now (grep finds no live or analysis consumer outside tests)
rows.proposed_fix: join on the latest row whose known_at <= ts (ml.timing_alignment.last_bar_known_by), or delete the macro path

rows.inputs_and_clocks: every ticker forward-filled onto a UTC calendar. The as-of date written is the row label, not the date of the last genuine observation
rows.issue: staleness mask: e.g. feature-store row 2026-09-20 records gold_usd_asof_date 2026-09-19, a Saturday with no COMEX session. gold_usd_change_1d = 0 on filled days, and gold_usd_5d_vol mixes filled zero-returns (biased low)
rows.published_result_at_risk: no published result found that reads the as-of fields
rows.proposed_fix: keep a genuine-observation mask per ticker (as ml/direction/comex_daily.py does) and write its date as *_asof_date. Compute returns and vols on genuine days only

rows.analysis: Feature store: backfill vs live rows
rows.inputs_and_clocks: backfill (114 of 221 rows): macro row D = GC=F settle D (17:30 UTC) and US closes (~20-21 UTC), stored with IBJA PM D (11:30 UTC). live_pit (107 rows): captured ~12:00-13:00 UTC with Yahoo's partial intraday bar
rows.issue: leak plus train/serve skew. Backfill features include 6-9 h of price action after the IBJA fix they sit beside; live rows do not. For h=1 labels (next PM minus this PM), that is part of the target window
rows.published_result_at_risk: no: a leak biases toward finding an edge, and the INR direction model found none (ADR 040), so 'no edge' stands a fortiori
rows.proposed_fix: backfill macro with the last value known by 11:30 UTC D (1-hour bars), or by the D-1 settle, and tag each row's clock

rows.inputs_and_clocks: target settle(i)/settle(i-1). Features *_lag1 include ^VIX, ^TNX, DXY, CL=F, TIP closes of day i-1 (16:00-17:00 ET), 2.5-3.5 h after the settle(i-1) that anchors the target
rows.issue: partial leak: the features see the first hours of the target window. ^BSESN, ^INDIAVIX and INR=X lag1 values are fine
rows.published_result_at_risk: no: this biases toward an edge, and none was found (ADR 040, #2000)
rows.proposed_fix: use the D-1 values known by 13:30 ET (1-hour bars), or lag the US closes by 2 rows

rows.inputs_and_clocks: event day = decision date D's GC=F settle (13:30 ET), before the 14:00 ET decision
rows.issue: misalignment: the decision is priced in bar D+1. The registered 'FOMC days move less' (ratio 0.674) measured the quiet pre-announcement session
rows.published_result_at_risk: yes: ADR 050 FOMC row (already flagged in its own audit)
rows.proposed_fix: event session = ml.timing_alignment.first_bar_after(decision_utc, bars, clock), per market

rows.inputs_and_clocks: 08:30 ET releases, inside the D bar (settle 13:30 ET D)

rows.where: ml/event_watch.py on the ADR 032 label series
rows.inputs_and_clocks: speech ~11:00 IST D (05:30 UTC). Label D = GC=F settle D (reflects it) x INR=X D (snapshot ~00-02 UTC, does not) x duty step dated D
rows.issue: partial misalignment: the FX reaction lands on D+1. The duty step is applied on the speech date (IBJA reprices that day, so broadly right)
rows.published_result_at_risk: possibly: ratio 1.48, p 0.167, n 17 (not significant either way)
rows.action: none (n = 17 is too small to re-run usefully)
rows.proposed_fix: measure budget moves on IBJA's first publication after the speech, once IBJA data is dense

rows.inputs_and_clocks: FOMC rows = last day of each meeting range, unscheduled included
rows.issue: data defect (not timing): the 2019-09-18 regular meeting is missing (federalreserve.gov fomchistorical2019.htm). Unscheduled actions with non-14:00 ET times (2019-10-11, 2020-03-03, 2020-03-15) are mixed in
rows.action: fixed in ADR 058 Part 2's event list
rows.proposed_fix: add 2019-09-18; add a per-row release time and a scheduled/unscheduled flag

rows.inputs_and_clocks: COMEX Monday settle (13:30 ET = 23:00/00:00 IST) mapped to the Indian Tuesday (INDIAN_TUE_SEES = 0)
each retailer reading paired with the IBJA fix in force at its IST time (>= 17:00 PM; 12:00-17:00 AM; < 12:00 previous PM)
rows.issue: none found. Residual: fix publish times are assumed, not measured. Kalyan timestamps are corrupt since 2026-09-08 (known)
rows.proposed_fix: record IBJA's actual publish time per fix when scraping

rows.analysis: R2 nowcast weekend 'global move' (M4/M5, #1957) and scorecard (#2015)
rows.inputs_and_clocks: truth = last Tanishq reading per UTC date (93 of 123 are 00:00-05:29 IST the next day; the value differs from IST-day grouping on 3 of 121 days). Move = (GC=F x INR=X bar before the truth date) / (bar before the IBJA date)
rows.issue: misalignment: for a Saturday board the move is settle(Fri)/settle(Thu). That double-counts Thu 17:30 -> Fri 11:30 UTC (already in Friday's PM fix) and misses Fri 17:30 -> 21:00 UTC
rows.published_result_at_risk: yes: 'a COMEX x USD/INR adjustment makes weekend days worse' (M4 122.8 vs M0 96.1 Rs/g, n 28)
rows.proposed_fix: move = price known when the board was set / price known at the IBJA fix (ml.timing_alignment.asof_intraday on 1-hour bars)

rows.inputs_and_clocks: premium(t) = IBJA PM(t) / parity from GC=F and INR=X of t-1 (settle ~18 h before the fix)
rows.issue: misalignment: the settle -> fix gold move enters the premium as near-i.i.d. noise. C (AR(1) shrinkage) damps that noise; B1 carries it forward. So H1 (C beats B1) can pass from timing noise rather than premium dynamics
rows.published_result_at_risk: yes: the interpretation of ADR 046's registered H1 (forward read ~2027-04), and the exploratory 2022-2026 numbers
rows.proposed_fix: parity at the fix time for the premium, and parity at prediction time (before the AM fix) for the forecast, from 1-hour bars; amend ADR 046 before its forward read

rows.inputs_and_clocks: Tanishq board by UTC date vs the same-date IBJA PM. The board is set ~11:00 IST, before the PM fix (17:00 IST)
rows.issue: evaluation-vs-use mismatch: before the IBJA AM fix, the live band is built on the previous PM, while the evaluation pairs same-date PM. Coverage for morning viewers is likely below the measured 72%
rows.published_result_at_risk: direction only: the published coverage is optimistic for morning viewers (not re-run)
rows.proposed_fix: score the band with the IBJA fix in force at each reading's time (ml/markup.py's rule)

rows.analysis: Driver attribution ('why did the price move', LIVE)
rows.where: ml/drivers.py (called from ml/inference.py; copy in app.js)
rows.inputs_and_clocks: IBJA PM D (11:30 UTC) joined to macro row D: the GC=F settle (17:30 UTC) when cached after it, or a partial intraday bar during a run
rows.issue: misalignment, user-facing: gold moves after the fix are attributed to 'premium / local factors', at both window ends
rows.published_result_at_risk: yes: live copy, not a research result
rows.proposed_fix: use COMEX x FX known at each IBJA fix, or D-1 settles at both window ends consistently

rows.inputs_and_clocks: a single series each (IBJA or Tanishq)
as_of_date (IST) per capture, retailer observed_at (UTC). The scorecard joins it to the UTC-date Tanishq truth
rows.issue: minor: IST vs UTC day keys, which agree on 118 of 121 days
rows.proposed_fix: key everything by IST board date
